requirements.title: No buoy strikes

requirements.title: Tethered pair alternate course
requirements.detail: A USV tethered to the UUV may use a gate of two buoys about 2 m apart with a marker at least 10 m beyond, both extending far enough below the surface to navigate by. The UUV stays submerged throughout, both craft are visibly autonomous with hands off the controllers, and the USV may follow the UUV through the course.

requirements.title: Run start sequence in rc-test logs
requirements.detail: rc-test logs showing the run start sequence of 3.4.10: retained RxCourse, RunDeclaration, every declared vehicle heartbeating STATE_AUTO, then RunStart, whose declaration_seq the OCS checks against the declaration it sent.

requirements.title: At least two vehicles in the declaration
requirements.detail: The run start sequence must be performed with at least two vehicles in the run_declaration message.

requirements.title: The log file itself
requirements.detail: Keep the session log rc-test writes and attach it to the submission. `robotx rc-check --broker <host>` drives the sequence against it.

criteria.label: Started 3 m behind the gate
criteria.rule: distance from the start point to the gate line >= 3 m

criteria.label: Passed through the first gate
criteria.rule: crossed the gate line between the red and green buoy

criteria.label: Passed through the second gate
criteria.rule: crossed the second gate line between its buoys

criteria.label: No buoy struck
criteria.rule: hull clearance to every buoy stayed above 0 m

criteria.label: Autonomous for the whole run
criteria.rule: the vehicle reported AUTO from start to finish

criteria.label: Good autonomous control
criteria.rule: heading held to the gate line within 25 degrees at each crossing

criteria.label: Visual feedback shown
criteria.rule: the status light was shown in AUTO, MANUAL and KILLED

criteria.label: Kill switches demonstrated
criteria.rule: onboard and remote kill both stopped the vehicle

criteria.label: Started 3 m behind the gate
criteria.rule: distance from the start point to the gate >= 3 m

criteria.label: Passed through the gate
criteria.rule: crossed the gate plane under the 1 m bar, inside the 2 m width

criteria.label: Circled the marker
criteria.rule: swept a full turn around the marker 10 m beyond the gate

criteria.label: Returned through the gate
criteria.rule: crossed the gate plane a second time, outbound to inbound

criteria.label: Never breached the surface
criteria.rule: depth stayed below 0.3 m for the whole run

criteria.label: Nothing floating on the surface
criteria.rule: no attached part of the vehicle was above the waterline

criteria.label: Gate and marker not struck
criteria.rule: clearance to the gate legs, the bar and the marker stayed above 0 m

criteria.label: Autonomous for the whole run
criteria.rule: the vehicle reported AUTO from start to finish

criteria.label: Visual feedback shown
criteria.rule: the status light was shown in AUTO, MANUAL and KILLED

criteria.label: Onboard kill demonstrated
criteria.rule: the onboard kill stopped the vehicle

criteria.label: Tethered pair both autonomous
criteria.rule: on the alternate course, USV and UUV both reported AUTO throughout

criteria.label: Manual mode shown
criteria.rule: the flight mode indicator read MANUAL before takeoff

criteria.label: Manual takeoff above 3 m AGL
criteria.rule: peak altitude on the takeoff leg > 3 m

criteria.label: Manual pattern flown
criteria.rule: all four pattern points reached in order at the hover altitude

criteria.label: Manual geofence held
criteria.rule: commanded past the boundary, the vehicle stayed inside it

criteria.label: Manual ceiling held
criteria.rule: commanded above the ceiling, the vehicle stayed below it

criteria.label: Manual landing
criteria.rule: landed within 2 m of the takeoff point

criteria.label: Autonomous mode shown
criteria.rule: the flight mode indicator read AUTO before takeoff

criteria.label: Autonomous takeoff above 3 m AGL
criteria.rule: peak altitude on the takeoff leg > 3 m

criteria.label: Autonomous pattern flown
criteria.rule: all four pattern points reached in order at the hover altitude

criteria.label: Autonomous geofence held
criteria.rule: commanded past the boundary, the vehicle stayed inside it

criteria.label: Autonomous ceiling held
criteria.rule: commanded above the ceiling, the vehicle stayed below it

criteria.label: Autonomous landing
criteria.rule: landed within 2 m of the takeoff point

criteria.label: Link loss handled
criteria.rule: on a simulated controller link loss the vehicle returned and landed

criteria.label: Retained RxCourse received
criteria.rule: the course configuration arrived before the declaration

criteria.label: Two vehicles declared
criteria.rule: run_declaration named at least two vehicles

criteria.label: Every declared vehicle autonomous
criteria.rule: each declared vehicle heartbeat STATE_AUTO before RunStart

criteria.label: RunStart received
criteria.rule: RoboCommand released the run

criteria.label: RunStart verified
criteria.rule: RunStart quoted the sequence number of our own RunDeclaration
